# Focus

Focus is a dark-only theme that its recorded description presents as minimizing distraction and highlighting the content of a note. Clean typography and subtle contrasts are the stated means, and the theme index agrees that only dark mode is offered.

![Focus screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mprojectscode/obsidian-focus-theme/HEAD/FocusThemeImage.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Focus"
    author: "Moritz Jung"
    repo:   "mprojectscode/obsidian-focus-theme"
    slug:   "focus"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/focus"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/mprojectscode/obsidian-focus-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mprojectscode/obsidian-focus-theme/HEAD/FocusThemeImage.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Focus on the important parts of your notes with a dark-only Obsidian theme that minimizes distractions and highlights content. Use clean typography and subtle contrasts to keep attention on your writing."
}
```
